views.label: Component catalog
views.summary: Every receiver, processor, exporter, extension, connector and scraper in contrib as clickable islands — coloured by stability, filterable by name, class, signal and code owner.

views.label: Data-flow pipeline
views.summary: The three signal lines — traces, metrics and logs — with receivers, processors and exporters placed on them and connectors bridging between lines.

views.label: Code architecture
views.summary: How the contrib repository is laid out: confmap, internal, pkg, cmd, config, testbed, docs and .chloggen, plus the Go modules and Makefile machinery behind them.

views.label: Contribution workflow
views.summary: The ordered journey from finding an issue to a merged pull request, with the contrib file and command behind every stop.

views.label: Glossary
views.summary: Every term the atlas uses, defined once and linked to the contrib source that evidences it.

regions.label: Receivers
regions.summary: Ingest telemetry from a source — a socket, a file, an API or a scrape target — and hand it to the pipeline as traces, metrics or logs.

regions.label: Processors
regions.summary: Transform, filter, sample, batch or enrich telemetry between receivers and exporters.

regions.label: Exporters
regions.summary: Terminate a pipeline by sending telemetry to a backend such as an OTLP endpoint, Prometheus or a message queue.

regions.label: Extensions
regions.summary: Provide capabilities outside the telemetry pipeline itself: auth, health checks, storage, observers and OpAMP.

regions.label: Connectors
regions.summary: Consume from one pipeline and produce into another, bridging signals such as traces to metrics or fanning one stream into several.

regions.label: Scrapers
regions.summary: Pull metrics from a target on a schedule; scrapers are composed into receivers such as the hostmetrics receiver.

regions.label: confmap
regions.summary: Configuration mapping: resolves config URIs and providers so YAML is turned into typed component configuration.

regions.label: internal
regions.summary: Packages shared only inside this repository — the place for code that must not become public API.

regions.label: pkg
regions.summary: Public Go modules meant for external consumption, such as ottl, stanza and the golden test helpers.

regions.label: cmd
regions.summary: Binaries built from this repository: otelcontribcol, oteltestbedcol, telemetrygen, opampsupervisor and the code generators.

regions.label: config
regions.summary: Shared configuration packages used by components, currently the database auth configuration helpers.

regions.label: testbed
regions.summary: The controlled environment for end-to-end, correctness, stability and load tests of the collector.

regions.label: docs
regions.summary: Contributor-facing documentation: donating new components, testing guidance, the release process and ready-made PR text.

regions.label: .chloggen
regions.summary: One YAML entry per user-facing change; chloggen folds them into CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG-API.md at release time.

regions.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
regions.summary: The contributor entry point: local testing, changelog rules, PR titles, labels via comments, roles and Makefile guidelines.

regions.label: issue-triaging.md
regions.summary: Issue roles, the triage process, label definitions and the state diagram every new issue moves through.

regions.label: Issue templates
regions.summary: The structured forms used to file bug reports, feature requests, new component donations and component graduations.

regions.label: Pull request template
regions.summary: The sections every pull request must fill in: description, tracking issue, testing, documentation and authorship.

regions.label: CODEOWNERS
regions.summary: Maps every path in the repository to the people notified to review changes to it; generated from metadata.yaml.

regions.label: GitHub workflows
regions.summary: CI and release automation, including the script that decides which modules a pull request has to test.

regions.label: distributions.yaml
regions.summary: The list of distributions a component may declare membership in from its metadata.yaml.

regions.label: Makefile
regions.summary: Repo-level targets that wrap the per-module targets in Makefile.Common for the whole repository.

regions.label: .mdatagen.yaml
regions.summary: Repository-wide mdatagen configuration: lifecycle tests, goleak and feature gate exclusions per component.

regions.label: .schemagen.yaml
regions.summary: schemagen configuration: type mappings, allowed external refs and per-component overrides that steer how Go config structs become config.schema.yaml.

regions.label: builder-config.yaml
regions.summary: The manifest of components compiled into the otelcontribcol binary of the contrib distribution.

regions.label: Component directory
regions.summary: One directory per component — for example receiver/prometheusreceiver/ — holding metadata.yaml, factory and config sources, go.mod, generated documentation and tests.
